items.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique
items.tldr: 水擴張治療黏連性肩關節囊炎之系統性回顧顯示，相較於類固醇注射或物理治療，其臨床改善證據有限，且最佳注射體積與次數仍未定論。
items.journal: British journal of sports medicine

items.title: Understanding Anterior Cruciate Ligament Adaptation: Structural, Mechanical, and Healing Considerations
items.tldr: 敘述性回顧指出ACL為機械感應組織，其適應受負載、性別及成熟度影響，整合阻力訓練可增強韌帶韌性並降低受傷風險。
items.journal: Sports medicine (Auckland, N.Z.)

items.title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists are associated with improved 90-day outcomes after total hip and knee arthroplasty : a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.tldr: 系統性回顧顯示GLP-1受體激動劑或可降低全髖膝置換術90天併發症及再住院率，但證據品質極低。
items.journal: The bone & joint journal

items.title: Arthroscopic Labral Repair Versus Debridement for Femoroacetabular Impingement: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of 2730 Hips
items.tldr: 系統性回顧顯示，股髖撞擊症關節鏡下盂唇修復較清創能顯著降低全髖置換風險及長期疼痛，但功能分數結果因研究設計不同而不一致。
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Intra-articular Orthobiologics Show Statistically but Not Clinically Meaningful Improvements Compared With Viscosupplementation in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Network Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
items.tldr: 網際網路統合分析顯示，膝骨關節炎使用正交生物學注射雖統計顯著優於透明質酸，但未達臨床重要差異，且影像學結果不一致。
items.journal: Arthroscopy : the journal of arthroscopic & related surgery : official publication of the Arthroscopy Association of North America and the International Arthroscopy Association

items.title: Medial Quadriceps Tendon-Femoral Ligament Reconstruction Offers Favorable Clinical Outcomes and Low Complication Rates for Recurrent Patellar Instability: A Systematic Review
items.tldr: 系統性回顧顯示，MQTFLR結合MPFLR治療復發性髌骨不穩，功能分數佳、再脫位率低，且併發症少於單獨手術。
items.journal: Arthroscopy : the journal of arthroscopic & related surgery : official publication of the Arthroscopy Association of North America and the International Arthroscopy Association

items.title: Positive Response to Preoperative Intra-articular Anesthetic Injection Suggests Favorable Outcomes After Hip Arthroscopy in Patients With Femoroacetabular Impingement Syndrome: A Systematic Review
items.tldr: 系統性回顧顯示，股髖撞擊症術前關節內麻醉注射反應正向者術後結果較佳，但負向反應無法預測不良結果，證據有限。
items.journal: Arthroscopy : the journal of arthroscopic & related surgery : official publication of the Arthroscopy Association of North America and the International Arthroscopy Association

items.title: Isolated Hip Arthroscopy Provides Comparable Mid- to Long-Term Outcomes in Borderline Hip Dysplasia and Normal Hips: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.tldr: 系統性回顧顯示，邊緣性髖關節發育不良患者接受單純髖關節鏡術後，其中長期臨床結果、翻修率及髖關節存活率與正常組無顯著差異。
items.journal: Arthroscopy : the journal of arthroscopic & related surgery : official publication of the Arthroscopy Association of North America and the International Arthroscopy Association

items.title: Hip Arthroscopy in Adults Aged 40 or Older Produces Clinically Meaningful Symptom Improvement but Carries a Substantial Risk of Conversion to Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Systematic Review
items.tldr: 四十歲以上髖關節鏡術後症狀顯著改善，但轉全髖置換率達5%至21%，且大於四十五歲者功能較差，併發症率低。
items.journal: Arthroscopy : the journal of arthroscopic & related surgery : official publication of the Arthroscopy Association of North America and the International Arthroscopy Association

items.title: Complications after anterior closing-wedge high tibial osteotomy in anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A state-of-the-art technical review
items.tldr: 前傾斜角增高ACL重建併行前側閉合楔形高脛骨截骨術併發症報告不一致，證據有限，需個體化規劃以減低風險。

items.title: Rectus femoris tendon autograft yields comparable early outcomes to hamstring tendon autograft, but evidence remains limited: A systematic review

items.journal: Knee surgery, sports traumatology, arthroscopy : official journal of the ESSKA

items.title: Younger age and platelet-rich plasma characteristics influence short-term outcomes in knee osteoarthritis, but independent effects remain uncertain: A systematic review with meta-analysis and meta-regression of placebo-controlled randomised trials

items.journal: Knee surgery, sports traumatology, arthroscopy : official journal of the ESSKA

items.title: Autologous adipose-derived mesenchymal stromal cell injection for knee osteoarthritis improves pain and function without a clear increase in adverse events: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.tldr: 六項隨機對照試驗顯示自體脂肪幹細胞注射改善膝骨關節炎疼痛與功能，不良事件未顯著增加，但證據異質性高且缺乏結構性改善。
items.journal: Knee surgery, sports traumatology, arthroscopy : official journal of the ESSKA

items.title: Promises and limitations of deep learning for predicting knee osteoarthritis progression from medical imaging: A systematic review
items.tldr: 系統回顧顯示深度學習預測膝骨關節炎進展具概念驗證，但外部驗證效能下降且方法學風險高，臨床應用前仍需標準化定義與多中心驗證。
items.journal: Knee surgery, sports traumatology, arthroscopy : official journal of the ESSKA

items.title: Medial meniscus posterior root repair with concomitant centralization does not demonstrate superior reduction of meniscal extrusion or improved clinical outcomes compared with isolated repair: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.tldr: 系統性回顧顯示，內側半月板後根修復加中央化未顯著改善外翻或臨床結果，證據異質性高，需更多隨機對照試驗。
items.journal: Knee surgery, sports traumatology, arthroscopy : official journal of the ESSKA

items.title: Age- and time-specific management of traumatic anterior shoulder instability: The 2024 ESSKA-ESA Formal Consensus. Part 2: Treatment and return to sports
items.tldr: 2024 ESSKA-ESA共識提供創傷性前肩關節不穩治療與重返運動建議，強調依年齡、復發狀態及骨損傷個別化決策，證據等級多為中低。

items.title: Short Term Results of Structural Bone Grafting of Glenoid Defects in Reverse Total Shoulder Arthroplasty: A Systematic Review/Meta-analysis of Implant Design and Graft Characteristics
items.tldr: 系統性回顧顯示自體與異體骨移植融合率均高，但翻修手術基座鬆脫及再手術率顯著高於初術，長期效果待證。
